days.title: Hanoi → Taipei · Raohe Night Market

cost.note: Estimate ~NT$7,000-9,500 per night for a standard king (Nov weekdays). Book a free-cancellation rate.

stay.note: Check-in from 15:00. Nov 6: pack before going out, check out and leave bags with the concierge (or ask for late check-out).

days.dayNote:
**Clocks go forward 1 h** (Vietnam UTC+7 → Taiwan UTC+8).

- **Arrival:** TPE T2. The Taiwan online arrival card is a flights.json todo. Buy an **EasyCard** at the Airport MRT counter or any 7-Eleven. It works on the MRT, buses, TRA trains and in convenience stores.
- **With lots of luggage** (Hoi An tailoring): a taxi from the T2 rank is ~NT$1,300-1,500 and 50-70 min at rush hour, against ~70 min by Airport MRT.
- **Raohe food:** Fuzhou black-pepper buns (福州世祖胡椒餅) at the temple gate (the queue moves fast), Chen Dong herbal pork-rib soup (陳董藥燉排骨), grilled mochi, oyster vermicelli, stinky tofu.
- **Too tired?** Linjiang Street (Tonghua) Night Market (臨江街夜市) is 10 min from the hotel by taxi.

leg.label: Airport MRT express + MRT · TPE T2 → Zhongxiao Fuxing
leg.note: Express trains every ~15 min (purple). Take the lift at A1 and follow the signs to the Blue line (~10 min walk underground).

items.title: Check in · Kimpton Da An
items.note: Drop bags and freshen up. Taxi to Raohe ~15-20 min (~NT$250), or MRT Brown → Green line to Songshan ~25 min.
Lit up at night; Raohe's east gate is right outside.

items.title: Dinner · Raohe Night Market
items.note: Graze: black-pepper buns at the gate, herbal pork-rib soup, grilled mochi, oyster vermicelli. Cash (NT$100s) and a small bag for rubbish.

days.title: Taipei · Palace Museum + Da'an
days.dayNote:
- **Palace Museum:** Tue-Sun 09:00-17:00 (tickets until 16:30), closed Mon, NT$350. Rent the audio guide. The Jadeite Cabbage and Meat-shaped Stone sometimes move to the Southern Branch, so check the exhibit list the week before.
- **Getting there:** Red line to Shilin, then bus R30/255/304/815 (~15 min), or a taxi from Fu Hang (~25 min, ~NT$350).
- **Lunch instead:** Din Tai Fung's Xinyi Rd flagship (No. 194, Sec. 2 Xinyi Rd), at the top of Yongkang Street.
- **Yongkang:** Smoothie House (思慕昔) shaved ice (mango is out of season in Nov; try other flavours) and the tea shops.
- **Bars after Mume:** Indulge (200 m from the hotel; book), then Draft Land (walk-in). Also on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2025 in Taipei: The Public House (#40), To Infinity & Beyond (#41), Lab (#57), Bar Mood (#72), UnderLab (#73, Da'an). Check where each is and book.
- **Rain plan:** swap Daan Forest Park for Huashan 1914 or the Eslite bookstore at Songyan.

items.title: Breakfast · Fu Hang Soy Milk
items.note: Queue 30-60 min even on weekdays; go by ~07:15. Order sweet or salty soy milk plus the thick baked flatbread with egg (厚餅夾蛋). Cash only. Closed Mondays.
Opens 09:00; start with the 3F highlights before the tour groups arrive. Closed Mon (Wed is fine).

items.title: Lunch · Silks Palace
items.note: Dim sum and the replica Jadeite Cabbage / Meat-shaped Stone dishes. Book a table (phone or online). Fallback: the museum's Sanxitang tea room (4F).

items.title: Yongkang Street · shaved ice + tea shops
items.note: Smoothie House (思慕昔) shaved ice; browse the teahouses. Dongmen MRT (Red line) from Shilin.
~15 min walk from Yongkang. Loop past the pond (egrets and turtles). Walk back to the hotel along Xinsheng S. Rd / Ren'ai Rd (~20 min).

items.title: Dinner · Mume
items.note: Tasting menu (1 Michelin star). Book on mume.tw or call +886 2 2700 0901. Tell them about dietary needs. ~8 min walk from the hotel.

cost.note: Estimate: tasting menu + 10% service, drinks extra

items.note: Tea-based signature cocktails. Reserve (inline/phone); look for the herb garden at the door.
Optional nightcap; cocktails on tap, walk-in.

days.title: Shifen + Jiufen · waterfall, Teapot Mountain, lanterns
days.dayNote:
Weekday on purpose: Jiufen is packed at weekends and midday. **~4.5 h of travel** today (day trip, flagged).

- **Train:** check the TRA timetable the night before (TRA app/website). Aim for a Ruifang train around 08:20 and a Pingxi Line connection that reaches Shifen ~10:00. The Pingxi Line runs about hourly. Tap an EasyCard (no reservation). The Pingxi day pass (NT$80) only pays off if you also stop at Houtong (cat village) or Jingtong.
- **Teapot Mountain is optional.** The trail goes from the Gold Museum past the Golden Shrine, ~1 h up, and ends in a short rope scramble. Skip it in rain or wind (the NE monsoon makes Jiufen/Jinguashi among the wettest places in Taiwan in Nov). Then take a taxi from Shifen straight to Jiufen and add the Gold Museum's Benshan Fifth Tunnel, or Houtong.
- **Jiufen at dusk:** sunset ~17:10 and the lanterns come on then. The Spirited Away view is A-Mei Teahouse (阿妹茶樓) on Shuqi Road, shot from the stairs opposite. Weekday stalls start closing ~19:00-20:00, so eat as you go.
- **Back to Taipei:** bus **1062** from the Jiufen Old Street stop to Zhongxiao Fuxing MRT (3 min from the hotel), ~70-90 min, ~NT$113, EasyCard. Expect an evening queue. Or bus 965 to Beimen/Taipei Main, or bus 788 to Ruifang + TRA.

items.title: Breakfast near the hotel
items.note: Any Taiwanese breakfast shop (蛋餅 egg crepe, soy milk), or pick something up at 7-Eleven. Buy water and snacks for the train.

items.title: Taipei Main Station · TRA eastbound
items.note: Blue line from Zhongxiao Fuxing (4 stops). TRA platforms are on B2; any train stopping at Ruifang (local, Tze-Chiang, Chu-Kuang).

leg.label: TRA + Pingxi Line · Taipei → Ruifang → Shifen

cost.note: TRA NT$49 (local) to NT$76 (Tze-Chiang) + Pingxi Line ~NT$20-30

leg.note: Not reserved. Timings are typical; the Ruifang wait depends on the hourly Pingxi Line departures.

items.note: Release a sky lantern on the tracks (~NT$250-300 for a 4-colour lantern; staff paint and photograph it). Step off the rails when the train comes through.
~20 min walk from the station, over the Jingan suspension bridge. Open 09:00-16:30 in Nov, free. Taxis wait at the car park by the visitor centre.

leg.label: Taxi · Shifen → Gold Museum (Jinguashi)
leg.note: Skipping Teapot Mountain? Ask for Jiufen Old Street instead (~35 min, similar fare).

items.title: Lunch · Gold Museum miner's lunchbox
items.note: The miner's lunchbox (礦工便當) comes with a tin box and cloth wrap you keep. Park entry NT$80 pp; the Benshan Fifth Tunnel is inside if you skip the hike.
OPTIONAL. 2.5-3 h round trip from the Gold Museum via the Golden Shrine. Stairs, then a rope scramble to the top (skip that part if wet). Wear shoes with grip and bring water. Be back down by ~16:15.

items.title: Jiufen Teahouse · tea at sunset
items.note: Gongfu-style oolong service with a view over the valley (tea + water fee per person; ~NT$500-700 for two). Ask for a window seat.

items.title: Dinner · A-Gan-Yi taro balls + Old Street snacks
items.note: Taro balls in the dining room with the sea view, then graze on Jishan Street: fish-ball soup, peanut ice-cream roll (花生捲冰淇淋), braised pork rice. Stalls close ~19:00-20:00 on weekdays.

After dark with the lanterns lit: Jishan Street, then down the Shuqi Road stairs to A-Mei Teahouse (阿妹茶樓) for the classic photo. Crowds thin after ~19:00 on weekdays. Then bus 1062 back (see day note).

days.title: Taipei · Beitou hot springs + Dadaocheng (flex day)
days.dayNote:
**Flex day.** The Cities tab adds up to 31 days, so this is the spare one. Everything today is along the red MRT line (Beitou → Shuanglian/Daqiaotou).

- **Other ways to spend it:** Longshan Temple + Bopiliao (Wanhua); Maokong Gondola and a tea house (the gondola closes most Mondays); or move this day to Hoi An (allocation.flex).
- **Beitou:** the museum and Thermal Valley are closed on Mondays (Friday is fine). Public baths are gender-separated and nude; private rooms are for couples.
- **Breakfast:** e.g. Yonghe Soy Milk King (永和豆漿大王) on Fuxing S. Rd, Sec. 2 (open around the clock), or pastries near the hotel.
- **Ningxia picks:** Liu Yu Zai fried taro balls (劉芋仔), Fang Jia shredded chicken rice (方家雞肉飯), oyster omelette.
- **Friday nightcap** (optional): back in Da'an. Try whichever Asia's 50 Best bar you missed on Nov 3.

items.note: Opens 10:00, free, shoes off. Red line to Beitou, then change to Xinbeitou (~40 min from the hotel).
5 min uphill past the park. Hot and sulphurous; do not touch the water.

items.title: Hot-spring soak · private room (day use)
items.note: Several Beitou hotels rent private hot-spring rooms by the hour (e.g. Spring City Resort or Villa 32). Compare prices and book the day before. For a cheap public option there is Longnice Hot Spring (瀧乃湯, since 1907), gender-separated and nude.

items.title: Lunch near Xinbeitou Station
items.note: Beitou Market's upstairs food court (braised pork rice, noodle stalls) or ramen near the station.

Tea merchant since 1890 (Mon-Sat 09:00-18:00, closed Sun). Taste oolongs and buy tea (Shopping List: tea). Ask about the roasting-room tour (email ahead: service@wangtea.com.tw). Tax refund: ask whether they are a TRS store and bring your passport.
Dried fruit and mullet roe, Chinese herbs, Yongle fabric market, and the ArtYard (小藝埕) design shops. Shops close ~18:00-19:00.
Sunset ~17:10 over the Tamsui River. Container food and beer stalls open in the evening.

items.title: Dinner · Ningxia Night Market
items.note: ~15 min walk from the wharf. Liu Yu Zai taro balls, Fang Jia chicken rice, oyster omelette. Cash.

items.title: Nightcap · Da'an cocktail bar (optional)
items.note: The Public House, To Infinity & Beyond, Lab, Bar Mood or UnderLab (Asia's 50 Best 2025 list). Check locations and book.

days.title: Taipei · last day → fly home
days.dayNote:
- **Checkout:** pack before breakfast, check out, and leave the bags with the concierge (or ask for a 14:00 late check-out). **Leave the hotel by 18:05.**
- **Taiwan tax refund (TRS):** shops with the blue TRS sign, NT$2,000+ at one shop on one day. Bring your passport to the till. Small refunds can be paid in the shop; otherwise claim at the TPE tax-refund counter **before check-in** and keep the goods in your hand luggage in case customs asks to see them.
- **Alternatives:** Longshan Temple (Wanhua) instead of Huashan; Songshan Cultural Park + Eslite instead of the 101 mall.
- **Airport MRT instead of a taxi:** MRT to Taipei Main, then the express to T2 (~60 min door to door, NT$150 pp). Leave by 17:50.

items.title: Breakfast near the hotel
items.note: Last chance for Fu Hang Soy Milk (expect a ~1 h Saturday queue) or Yonghe Soy Milk King.

items.title: Check out · leave bags at Kimpton Da An

items.note: Be in the main hall on the hour for the honour-guard change. Photos from Liberty Square gate.

items.title: Lunch · Yong Kang Beef Noodle
items.note: ~15 min walk from CKS. Go at opening (~11:00) to beat the queue. Order the braised (紅燒) beef noodle soup; the half-tendon mix is a good choice. Cash.
Weekend design markets, pop-up exhibitions and Taiwanese brands.
Red line to Xiangshan. 20-30 min of steep stairs to the Six Giant Rocks viewpoint for the Taipei 101 shot. Skip it in heavy rain.

89F observatory (~NT$600, buy online; skip if the top is in cloud) or the mall. **Tax refund with passport:** most mall shops are TRS. NT$2,000+ at one shop on one day; keep the receipts for the TPE counter.

items.title: Early dinner · Din Tai Fung (Taipei 101)
items.note: Take a queue number first (kiosk or online queue), then browse. Order pork xiaolongbao, truffle xiaolongbao, shrimp fried rice and the spicy wontons. Aim to sit down by ~16:30.

items.title: Pick up bags · Kimpton Da An
items.note: ~15 min by taxi from Taipei 101.

leg.label: Taxi · Kimpton Da An → TPE T2
leg.note: Leave by 18:05 so you reach T2 by ~19:00. TK25 departs 21:45. Claim the TRS refund at the counter before Turkish check-in.

days.title: Istanbul layover → Newark
days.dayNote:
- **IST 05:10 → 18:50** (~13 h 40 m): the Turkish Airlines Business Lounge, or Touristanbul, the free city tour for transfer passengers with 6-24 h connections. Check eligibility and Türkiye entry rules before leaving the airport.
- **US clocks go back at 02:00 today:** the EWR arrival (~21:40) is in EST.

expenses.note: ~NT$113 pp by EasyCard. The ride itself is the autofilled stay leg from Jiufen Old Street to the hotel.

expenses.note: 2 cards (~NT$100 each; the card fee isn't refunded) + ~NT$400 each for MRT/buses over 4 days (estimate).

todos.note: Taiwan part of the Action Timeline row 'Hotels — Korea / Vietnam / Taiwan'. Rates ~NT$7,000-9,500/night. This is above the Taiwan lodging default of US$85 pp/day. For something cheaper nearby, look around Zhongxiao Fuxing / Zhongxiao Dunhua.

todos.note: Booking window not verified. Tables usually go ~1-2 months ahead; this todo fires 60 days before. Phone +886 2 2700 0901.

todos.note: Aim to reach Shifen ~10:00. If rain is forecast, drop Teapot Mountain (see the Nov 4 day note).

notes: File: written as seed/draft/days-taiwan.json (the name in SCHEMA.md and allocation.json parts.taiwan.file). The task text said 'taiwan.json'.

Priorities: all Taiwan places in the Places tab are unrated. The ranking uses the Cities-tab notes (night markets, street food, National Palace Museum, Daan Forest Park, Wang Tea, Da'an cocktail bars; Shifen waterfalls; Jiufen Old Street, Jiufen Teahouse, Teapot Mountain) plus judgment. Every Places-tab Taiwan place is scheduled: Teapot Mountain as an optional item on Nov 4.

New nodes: coordinates come from OpenStreetMap/Nominatim lookups (2026-09-23) and are marked high when OSM had the exact POI. Medium: area centroids, Draft Land (address conflict), Din Tai Fung Taipei 101 (pinned to the tower), Beitou Thermal Valley, and the bus stops in leg segments.

Hours confirmed on official sites 2026-09-23: National Palace Museum (Tue-Sun 09:00-17:00, closed Mon, NT$350), Wang Tea (Mon-Sat 09:00-18:00, closed Sun), Gold Museum (weekdays 09:30-17:00, weekends 09:30-18:00, closed 1st Mon, NT$80), Mume (daily 17:30-23:00, Michelin Guide). Every other openHours value comes from memory and is marked '(verify)'.

Lodging: Kimpton Da An at ~NT$8,000/night × 4 (~US$250/night) is above the allocation's Taiwan lodging default (US$85 pp/day ≈ US$170/night for two). It was chosen for the Da'an bar focus. The budget view will show Taiwan lodging over budget unless a cheaper hotel is picked.

Nov 4 has ~4.5 h of travel (Taipei → Shifen → Jinguashi → Jiufen → Taipei), over the ~2 h/day guideline. This is inherent to the day trip. Without Teapot Mountain the day drops to ~3.5 h of travel and ~390 item-minutes.

Return legs to the hotel (Nov 2 from Raohe, Nov 4 from Jiufen by bus 1062, Nov 5 from Ningxia) are left to stay-leg autofill (Google transit) because a day with a hotel stay can't end with a written leg. The bus 1062 fare is an explicit expense on Nov 4.
Nov 2 'after' half: the day title is set here ('Hanoi → Taipei · Raohe Night Market'). Lunch is on board BR398, so this half only has dinner.
Nov 7: only the TK25 marker plus a dayNote (IST layover ideas, DST).

Estimates to verify: Silks Palace hours and prices, the Mume tasting-menu price, the Taipei 101 observatory price, Beitou private-room prices, taxi fares (Shifen → Jinguashi, hotel → TPE), and bus 1062 fare and frequency.
